consts.name: dnhBureaucracyDutiesCount
consts.comment: the bureaucracy duties count - the spirit officials receive and carry out orders, punish the wicked, and file reports of their activities, three duties (print capture p. 253)

consts.name: dnhSpiritOfficialCharacterCount
consts.comment: the spirit official character count - like the bureaucrats of the real world the spirit officials can be corrupt, disobedient, just, or incompetent, four characters (print capture p. 253)

bools.name: dnhUnifiedWholeDoctrine
bools.comment: the unified whole doctrine - unlike the west viewing non-human creatures as a loose collection with no unity, the Oriental mind has organized the world into a unified whole (print capture p. 253)

bools.name: dnhEmperorHeadsBureaucracy
bools.comment: the emperor heads bureaucracy - the Celestial Emperor, a powerful being, heads the Celestial Bureaucracy, a type of government of the spirits (print capture p. 253)

bools.name: dnhSpiritsHoldOffices
bools.comment: the spirits hold offices - many spirit creatures come under his command and hold offices or positions within the Celestial Bureaucracy (print capture p. 253)

bools.name: dnhChasingLungRainDuty
bools.comment: the chasing lung rain duty - the chasing lung (river dragons) given the duty of making rain (print capture p. 253)

bools.name: dnhMinistryOfThunderChain
bools.comment: the ministry of thunder chain - the chasing lung report to the Ministry of Thunder, who in turn reports to the Celestial Emperor (print capture p. 253)

bools.name: dnhOfficialsLikeRealBureaucrats
bools.comment: the officials like real bureaucrats - the spirit officials can be corrupt, disobedient, just, or incompetent, like the bureaucrats of the real world (print capture p. 253)

bools.name: dnhAnnualExamination
bools.comment: the annual examination - the spirit officials can be replaced, each year their activities and behavior examined by their superiors (print capture p. 253)
